### Checklist

- [ ] Title follows the `<type>: <description>` convention (fix / feat / refactor / chore)
- [ ] I have tested this change and all available validation/linting checks pass
- [ ] This PR addresses a single bug, feature, refactor, or maintenance task
- [ ] No unrelated changes or formatting are included
- [ ] Existing repository structure, coding style, and conventions are followed
- [ ] No new external dependencies were introduced without prior discussion
- [ ] Compatibility is preserved, or a different approach was previously discussed
- [ ] Relevant documentation was updated, if applicable
- [ ] No sensitive data, credentials, or production-specific configuration is included
